edit.statement: Successfully authenticated TLS with uncompromised keys prevents a passive network observer from reading transferred plaintext.
edit.subject: A passive network observer’s plaintext-reading capability under authenticated, uncompromised TLS
edit.scope: All transfers satisfying the stated TLS conditions in the post-edit regime; confidentiality effect only, no additional authentication or integrity edits.

direct.prompt: With authenticated TLS, uncompromised keys and a passive network observer, what plaintext-reading capability does that observer have? Answer “able to read” or “unable to read.”

paraphrase.prompt: For a successfully authenticated, uncompromised TLS transfer, can a passive observer read the transferred plaintext?

cross_lingual.prompt: TLS认证成功、密钥未泄露时，被动网络观察者能否读取传输的明文？
Con TLS autenticado correctamente y claves no comprometidas, ¿puede un observador pasivo leer el texto en claro transferido?

derived.prompt: Connection N satisfies all the stated TLS conditions. What capability does its passive observer have for plaintext?
HTTPS connection N uses TLS and satisfies all the stated conditions. What capability does its passive observer have for the HTTP plaintext?
bridge: HTTPS connection N uses TLS and satisfies all the stated conditions.

derived.prompt: An audit labels traffic “exposed” if a passive observer can read it. N meets the TLS conditions. What label follows?
Given only the edited passive-observer readability rule, does server authentication succeed on an unspecified connection?
